Message:
🔔 DAY 143 (SATURDAY, MAY 23, 2026)
⛰️ ASCENDING MOUNT HOREB (AMH) – DAY 9 OF 40
📖 JOSHUA 1–2

🛐 Daily Insight (Swedenborg-inspired)
The transition from Moses to Joshua represents the shift from the literal instruction of the law to the active combat of living truth. Swedenborg teaches that entering Canaan signifies the church being established in the human soul. Rahab’s scarlet cord represents the saving power of genuine good within the heart, protecting us even in the midst of spiritual warfare.

🙏 Prayer
Lord, make me strong and courageous as I step into this new territory of faith. Let Your presence walk with me, and let the truth guide every boundary I cross today. Amen.

🔔 DAY 144 (SUNDAY, MAY 24, 2026)
⛰️ ASCENDING MOUNT HOREB (AMH) – DAY 10 OF 40
📖 JOSHUA 3–4

🛐 Daily Insight (Swedenborg-inspired)
The parting of the Jordan River represents introduction into the church and the initial removal of falsities that block our spiritual progress. Swedenborg notes that the twelve stones taken from the dry riverbed symbolize the foundational truths of the Word, which must be firmly established in our memory to remember the Lord's deliverance.

🙏 Prayer
Father, part every obstacle that stands between me and Your promises. Establish Your truths deep in my memory, that I may always declare Your marvelous works in my life. Amen.

🔔 DAY 145 (MONDAY, MAY 25, 2026)
⛰️ ASCENDING MOUNT HOREB (AMH) – DAY 11 OF 40
📖 JOSHUA 5–6

🛐 Daily Insight (Swedenborg-inspired)
The collapse of the walls of Jericho represents the overthrow of deeply rooted evils and false principles. Swedenborg explains that shouting and blowing the trumpets symbolize the powerful proclamation of Divine Truth from a heart full of love. When the Word is proclaimed in true faith, the defensive walls of our ego fall.

🙏 Prayer
Lord, let the walls of pride, doubt, and limitation crumble before Your presence. Bring down every internal stronghold that resists Your holy spirit in my life. Amen.

🔔 DAY 146 (TUESDAY, MAY 26, 2026)
⛰️ ASCENDING MOUNT HOREB (AMH) – DAY 12 OF 40
📖 JOSHUA 7–8

🛐 Daily Insight (Swedenborg-inspired)
Achan’s hidden sin and the initial defeat at Ai show how hidden selfishness disrupts our spiritual protection. Swedenborg teaches that spiritual victory is impossible while we secretly harbor or justify what is evil. True restoration and victory at Ai follow inner purification and complete transparency before the Lord.

🙏 Prayer
Search me, O God, and know my heart. Cleanse me from secret faults and help me live a life of complete integrity, so that Your power may rest upon me completely. Amen.

🔔 DAY 147 (WEDNESDAY, MAY 27, 2026)
⛰️ ASCENDING MOUNT HOREB (AMH) – DAY 13 OF 40
📖 JOSHUA 9–10

🛐 Daily Insight (Swedenborg-inspired)
The deception of the Gibeonites warns against relying on mere natural appearances without seeking divine counsel. Swedenborg teaches that the sun standing still in Gibeon represents the constant, undiminished flow of Divine Love and Light provided by the Lord when His people are engaged in spiritual combat against negativity.

🙏 Prayer
Father, grant me spiritual discernment so I am not deceived by outward appearances. I thank You for Your unwavering light that shines upon my battles, giving me total victory. Amen.

🔔 DAY 148 (THURSDAY, MAY 28, 2026)
⛰️ ASCENDING MOUNT HOREB (AMH) – DAY 14 OF 40
📖 JOSHUA 11–12

🛐 Daily Insight (Swedenborg-inspired)
The systematic conquest of the northern kings signifies the complete subjugation of diverse spiritual errors. Swedenborg explains that hamstrings on the enemy's horses represent disabling the destructive power of a perverted natural understanding. The Lord gives total rest once our lower nature is brought into subjection.

🙏 Prayer
Lord, disable every thought pattern and force that seeks to pull me away from Your order. Subdue every inner enemy and bring my mind into perfect alignment with Your peace. Amen.

🔔 DAY 149 (FRIDAY, MAY 29, 2026)
⛰️ ASCENDING MOUNT HOREB (AMH) – DAY 15 OF 40
📖 JOSHUA 13–14

🛐 Daily Insight (Swedenborg-inspired)
Caleb’s request for the mountain country at an advanced age shows that spiritual strength does not fade with time. Swedenborg teaches that inheriting specific lands corresponds to the unique placement of truths within our spiritual economy. Wholeness requires us to claim every spiritual gift the Lord has allotted to us.

🙏 Prayer
Father, give me the persistent faith of Caleb to claim my spiritual inheritance. Renew my strength daily during this fast, and let me possess the high places You have promised me. Amen.

🔔 DAY 150 (SATURDAY, MAY 30, 2026)
⛰️ ASCENDING MOUNT HOREB (AMH) – DAY 16 OF 40
📖 JOSHUA 15–17

🛐 Daily Insight (Swedenborg-inspired)
The allotment of land to Judah, Ephraim, and Manasseh represents how different principles of love and faith are organized within the human mind. Swedenborg notes that when daughters request inheritances, it signifies that pure affections for truth have a legitimate and honored place in the Lord's kingdom.

🙏 Prayer
Lord, organize my mind according to Your heavenly design. Let my love for Your truth find its rightful place, bearing fruit that honors Your name. Amen.

🔔 DAY 151 (SUNDAY, MAY 31, 2026)
⛰️ ASCENDING MOUNT HOREB (AMH) – DAY 17 OF 40
📖 JOSHUA 18–20

🛐 Daily Insight (Swedenborg-inspired)
The setting up of the Tabernacle at Shiloh and the establishment of the cities of refuge represent the centering of worship and divine mercy. Swedenborg explains that the cities of refuge symbolize the protection the Lord provides to those who make errors out of ignorance rather than malice, shielding them from spiritual condemnation.

🙏 Prayer
Father, be my sanctuary and my city of refuge. Protect my mind from the accusations of the adversary, and let Your mercy envelope me as I seek to walk uprightly. Amen.

🔔 DAY 152 (MONDAY, JUNE 1, 2026)
⛰️ ASCENDING MOUNT HOREB (AMH) – DAY 18 OF 40
📖 JOSHUA 21–22

🛐 Daily Insight (Swedenborg-inspired)
The Levites receiving cities scattered among all the tribes shows that spiritual devotion must permeate every aspect of life. Swedenborg notes that the misunderstanding over the altar built by the eastern tribes teaches that true worship is internal unity of spirit, not merely external appearance or ritual conformity.

🙏 Prayer
Lord, let Your spirit saturate every department of my life. Keep me unified with my brethren in true love, looking beyond outward perceptions to the sincerity of the heart. Amen.

🔔 DAY 153 (TUESDAY, JUNE 2, 2026)
⛰️ ASCENDING MOUNT HOREB (AMH) – DAY 19 OF 40
📖 JOSHUA 23–24

🛐 Daily Insight (Swedenborg-inspired)
Joshua’s final charge—"Choose this day whom you will serve"—sets the ultimate law of human free will. Swedenborg teaches that true faith can only be received and kept in freedom. When we declare, "As for me and my house, we will serve the Lord," we permanently bind our inner life to heaven.

🙏 Prayer
Father, with my whole heart and free will, I choose to serve You today and always. Let my household be a temple of Your presence, and let my life seal this covenant forever. Amen.

🔔 DAY 154 (WED, JUNE 3, 2026) ⛰️ AMH – DAY 20 OF 40
📖 Acts 1–2

🛐 Daily Insight (Swedenborg-inspired):
Jesus’ final instructions urge the disciples to wait for the Holy Spirit—a symbol of Divine Truth flowing into receptive hearts. The descent at Pentecost, with tongues of fire, signifies that the Lord’s spirit can fill all people who desire to love and understand truth. In the New Church, the outpouring of the Spirit marks the opening of our understanding to heavenly life and the power to witness to Divine Truth (Acts 2:1-4).

🙏 Prayer:
Lord, as You once filled the disciples, fill me with Your Spirit today. Open my mind to Your wisdom and let the fire of Your love rest upon my heart. Let me serve and witness in Your name. Amen.

🔔 DAY 155 (THU, JUNE 4, 2026) ⛰️ AMH – DAY 21 OF 40
📖 Acts 3–4

🛐 Daily Insight (Swedenborg-inspired):
Peter heals a lame man, showing that the Lord still brings wholeness to broken places in our lives. “Silver and gold have I none, but such as I have, give I thee.” True healing flows from faith and charity—not material things, but the living power of the Lord within us. When challenged, the apostles’ courage is from the Spirit, teaching us that heavenly power is granted when we rely on the Lord and speak in truth (Acts 3:6, 4:8).

🙏 Prayer:
Lord, let me share what I receive from You—spiritual wholeness, healing, and courage. Make my words and actions a testimony to Your living presence. Amen.

🔔 DAY 156 (FRI, JUNE 5, 2026) ⛰️ AMH – DAY 22 OF 40
📖 Acts 5–6

🛐 Daily Insight (Swedenborg-inspired):
The story of Ananias and Sapphira is a warning about hypocrisy in spiritual life; external profession without internal truth suffocates the soul. The apostles continue to work miracles, symbolizing how true faith, joined with charity, brings transformation. The ordination of deacons shows that the Church thrives when all serve according to their spiritual gifts (Acts 5:1-10, 6:3).

🙏 Prayer:
O Lord, purify my intentions. Let my service and gifts be fully consecrated to You. Breathe into me both truth and love, that my life may honor You in all things. Amen.

🔔 DAY 157 (SAT, JUNE 6, 2026) ⛰️ AMH – DAY 23 OF 40
📖 Acts 7

🛐 Daily Insight (Swedenborg-inspired):
Stephen’s speech traces the faith journey from Abraham to Christ, showing history as a living parable. His martyrdom reflects the resistance of the ego (the “old man”) to Divine Truth. Yet as Stephen beholds the heavens opened, we learn that those who remain in faith, even under trial, receive inward sight of heavenly realities (Acts 7:55-56).

🙏 Prayer:
Heavenly Father, help me to see above earthly trials to Your eternal kingdom. Strengthen me to bear witness with courage and forgive, as Stephen did, from a spirit of love. Amen.

🔔 DAY 158 (SUN, JUNE 7, 2026) ⛰️ AMH – DAY 24 OF 40
📖 Acts 8–9

🛐 Daily Insight (Swedenborg-inspired):
The conversion of Saul reveals how Divine Truth, even when resisted, can transform the hardest heart. Philip’s guidance of the Ethiopian shows that everyone seeking truth can find it when led by the Lord. The true miracle is not just healing or signs, but the change of our inner vision—spiritual rebirth (Acts 9:3-18).

🙏 Prayer:
Lord, remove my spiritual blindness and give me sight to know You. May my life, like Paul’s, be transformed by Your call and Your light within me. Amen.

🔔 DAY 159 (MON, JUNE 8, 2026) ⛰️ AMH – DAY 25 OF 40
📖 Acts 10

🛐 Daily Insight (Swedenborg-inspired):
Peter’s vision of the clean and unclean animals teaches that the Lord’s love and truth are offered to everyone—no one is spiritually unclean who receives the Lord in heart and life. The true Church is universal, formed of all who accept the influx of Divine life (Acts 10:34-35).

🙏 Prayer:
Lord, expand my heart to embrace all Your children. Help me see beyond externals to the living spirit within, and let Your love break down every barrier. Amen.

🔔 DAY 160 (TUE, JUNE 9, 2026) ⛰️ AMH – DAY 26 OF 40
📖 Acts 11–12

🛐 Daily Insight (Swedenborg-inspired):
Peter explains that the Holy Spirit is given to all who turn to God, affirming again the inclusivity of Divine mercy. The Church faces persecution, but miracles—like Peter’s deliverance—show that the Lord’s providence is still at work, opening doors in every prison (Acts 12:5-7).

🙏 Prayer:
Lord, in times of trial and uncertainty, remind me that You open ways where none seem possible. Strengthen my faith and help me trust Your unseen hand. Amen.

🔔 DAY 161 (WED, JUNE 10, 2026) ⛰️ AMH – DAY 27 OF 40
📖 Acts 13

🛐 Daily Insight (Swedenborg-inspired):
Paul’s first missionary journey begins, showing that truth proceeds from the Lord and travels far to reach open minds and hearts. Spiritual journeys are journeys of enlightenment—receiving, then spreading, the Word (Acts 13:2-3).

🙏 Prayer:
Use me, Lord, as Your messenger wherever You lead. Let my words reflect Your truth and my life Your love, so that others may be touched by You through me. Amen.

🔔 DAY 162 (THU, JUNE 11, 2026) ⛰️ AMH – DAY 28 OF 40
📖 Acts 14–15

🛐 Daily Insight (Swedenborg-inspired):
The apostles face both acceptance and resistance. The council at Jerusalem resolves disputes, showing that unity in the Church comes when love is joined with truth. The Church grows not when we impose burdens, but when we encourage faith expressing itself through love (Acts 15:28-29).

🙏 Prayer:
Lord, help me value harmony and peace. Let me live according to Your Spirit—holding fast to truth and abounding in love—so that my life may be a blessing to others. Amen.

🔔 DAY 163 (FRI, JUNE 12, 2026) ⛰️ AMH – DAY 29 OF 40
📖 Acts 16–17

🛐 Daily Insight (Swedenborg-inspired):
Paul and Silas sing in prison; the jailer is converted. Joy and faith are born not from circumstances, but from the Lord’s presence within. The noble Bereans remind us to receive the Word eagerly and search the Scriptures daily (Acts 16:25-34, 17:11).

🙏 Prayer:
O Lord, when darkness surrounds me, let Your light and joy rise within. Make my heart steadfast in searching Your Word, trusting Your presence in every trial. Amen.

🔔 DAY 164 (SAT, JUNE 13, 2026) ⛰️ AMH – DAY 30 OF 40
📖 Acts 18–19

🛐 Daily Insight (Swedenborg-inspired):
The teaching and healing in Corinth and Ephesus reveal that whenever Divine Truth is received, spiritual communities grow. Opposition may arise, but the genuine work of the Spirit brings transformation. True worshipers receive and act from the Lord’s love (Acts 18:9-10, 19:18-20).

🙏 Prayer:
Lord, establish Your Church within my heart. Let me be open to instruction and bold in sharing Your love and truth wherever I go. Amen.

🔔 DAY 165 (SUN, JUNE 14, 2026) ⛰️ AMH – DAY 31 OF 40
📖 Acts 20–21

🛐 Daily Insight (Swedenborg-inspired):
Paul’s farewell to the Ephesians reminds us that ministry is service, and that each of us is a shepherd, watching over our spiritual flock. There will be trials, but the Lord’s grace is sufficient for every need (Acts 20:24, 32).

🙏 Prayer:
Lord, keep me faithful in the care of all You entrust to me. Let Your grace and Word sustain me, and guide my steps in love. Amen.

🔔 DAY 166 (MON, JUNE 15, 2026) ⛰️ AMH – DAY 32 OF 40
📖 Acts 22–23

🛐 Daily Insight (Swedenborg-inspired):
Paul’s testimony before the people and council shows that every spiritual journey involves witness and the courage to stand for what is right. Divine Providence continues to lead and protect all who live in sincerity and faith (Acts 23:11).

🙏 Prayer:
Lord, empower me to stand for Your truth with humility and strength. Let my witness spring from love for You and for all people. Amen.

🔔 DAY 167 (TUE, JUNE 16, 2026) ⛰️ AMH – DAY 33 OF 40
📖 Acts 24–25

🛐 Daily Insight (Swedenborg-inspired):
Paul’s trials before governors teach us to be patient and steadfast amid misunderstandings and delay. The Lord’s timing is purposeful, allowing our faith to deepen and our trust to be perfected (Acts 24:16).

🙏 Prayer:
Father, in seasons of waiting or adversity, help me rest in Your Providence. Strengthen my patience and let my hope in You remain unshaken. Amen.

🔔 DAY 168 (WED, JUNE 17, 2026) ⛰️ AMH – DAY 34 OF 40
📖 Acts 26–28

🛐 Daily Insight (Swedenborg-inspired):
Paul bears witness to kings and is finally delivered to Rome, showing that the Lord can use all circumstances to spread the Gospel. The journey is never wasted when entrusted to Divine leading; every trial is turned into good and used for spiritual rebirth and sharing the Lord’s kingdom (Acts 28:30-31).

🙏 Prayer:
O Lord, use my journey—all my trials and blessings—for Your heavenly purposes. Make me ever willing to serve, testify, and trust in Your unfailing guidance. Amen.

🔔 DAY 169 (THU, JUNE 18, 2026) ⛰️ AMH – DAY 35 OF 40
📖 Judges 1–2

🛐 Daily Insight (Swedenborg-inspired):
As the Israelites begin possessing the land but fail to completely remove its corrupting inhabitants, we see our challenge to remove selfish tendencies from our hearts. Incomplete effort allows negative habits to remain and repeatedly trouble us. Yet, the Lord mercifully raises up deliverers—showing His continual effort to restore us and lead us toward spiritual freedom when we turn to Him (Judges 2:16-18; Arcana Coelestia 8595:2).

🙏 Prayer:
O Lord, show me where I leave selfishness unchallenged. Help me strive wholeheartedly for Your will, trusting in Your patient, leading love to deliver me. Amen.

🔔 DAY 170 (FRI, JUNE 19, 2026) ⛰️ AMH – DAY 36 OF 40
📖 Judges 3–4

🛐 Daily Insight (Swedenborg-inspired):
The cycles of oppression and deliverance reflect the spiritual battles within us. When evil gains ground, the Lord lets us feel its burden, not out of anger but so we choose good freely. Othniel, Ehud, and Deborah symbolize the power of truth and faith to set us free when we call on the Lord sincerely (Judges 3:9, 15; Judges 4:4-5). The Lord always gives new strength for renewal, no matter how many times we fall.

🙏 Prayer:
Lord, when I stumble and become captive to selfishness, awaken me again. Send Your renewing truth, and help me rise with courage to follow You. Amen.

🔔 DAY 171 (SAT, JUNE 20, 2026) ⛰️ AMH – DAY 37 OF 40
📖 Judges 5–6

🛐 Daily Insight (Swedenborg-inspired):
The song of Deborah celebrates victory by the Lord’s hand, reminding us that real triumph over evil and falsity comes from Him alone, not our own strength. Gideon's call, despite his doubts, encourages us to trust Divine guidance even when we feel weak or insignificant. The Lord sees what is good in us and calls us to step forward with faith, assuring us that He is with us (Judges 6:12-16).

🙏 Prayer:
Heavy Father, let me sing Your praise for every spiritual victory. Strengthen my trust—remind me You are with me in every test, even when I feel least able. Amen.

🔔 DAY 172 (SUN, JUNE 21, 2026) ⛰️ AMH – DAY 38 OF 40
📖 Judges 7–8

🛐 Daily Insight (Swedenborg-inspired):
Gideon’s few are chosen by the Lord to face overwhelming odds, showing that spiritual victory is not from numbers or worldly strength, but from reliance on Divine power. When we act from simple faith, humbly acknowledging the Lord as our Deliverer, He removes the obstacles and brings peace (Judges 7:2-7; Psalms 20:7; Arcana Coelestia 1917).

🙏 Prayer:
Lord, help me set aside pride and trust not in myself, but in Your might. May Your spirit guide my efforts, and grant victory through humility and faith. Amen.

🔔 DAY 173 (MON, JUNE 22, 2026) ⛰️ AMH – DAY 39 OF 40
📖 Judges 9

🛐 Daily Insight (Swedenborg-inspired):
The story of Abimelech warns of the dangers of self-love and selfish ambition. When we act for our own glory rather than the Lord’s, conflict and destruction soon follow. True leadership—and true peace—are grounded in service to the Lord and others, not in domination or pride (Judges 9:7-15; The Doctrine of the New Jerusalem Regarding the Sacred Scripture 15).

🙏 Prayer:
O Lord, purify my intentions. Let me serve for love of You and neighbor, never for selfish gain. Keep me humble, and build true peace within and around me. Amen.

🔔 DAY 174 (TUE, JUNE 23, 2026) ⛰️ AMH – DAY 40 OF 40
📖 Judges 10–11

🛐 Daily Insight (Swedenborg-inspired):
Repeated cycles of turning away and returning to God depict the patient mercy of the Lord. Even when we have wandered far, He longs for our return and answers our cries for help. Jephthah’s vow teaches us to consider carefully what we offer the Lord, seeking a pure and willing heart rather than outer acts alone (Judges 10:15-16; Arcana Coelestia 6301).

🙏 Prayer:
Lord, forgive my wanderings. Draw me back continually, and help my offerings be of a sincere heart and willing service to You. Amen.

🔔 DAY 175 (WED, JUNE 24, 2026)
📖 Judges 12–13

🛐 Daily Insight (Swedenborg-inspired):
The persistence of conflicts between the tribes and against external enemies reminds us that progress toward spiritual maturity is gradual. With Samson’s birth foretold, we learn the Lord always provides the means for deliverance—often before we know the solution is needed. Every challenge holds the seed of future strength (Judges 13:3-5).

🙏 Prayer:
O Lord, help me remember that every trial can become a blessing. Prepare me for victories yet to come and grant me patience in growth. Amen.

🔔 DAY 176 (THU, JUNE 25, 2026)
📖 Judges 14–15

🛐 Daily Insight (Swedenborg-inspired):
Samson’s feats reflect the potential of spiritual strength when we act in harmony with Divine truth, but also warn of the dangers of misusing our gifts for selfish ends. The Lord desires us to channel our strengths to serve good and be led by Him, not merely by personal desire (Judges 14:6, 14:19).

🙏 Prayer:
Lord, use my gifts and passions for Your purposes. Help me resist selfish motives, and let my strength serve Your kingdom in love. Amen.

🔔 DAY 177 (FRI, JUNE 26, 2026)
📖 Judges 16–17

🛐 Daily Insight (Swedenborg-inspired):
Samson’s downfall with Delilah shows how spiritual strength is lost when Divine truths are compromised by selfish loves. Yet, even in weakness, calling sincerely on the Lord invites His mercy and a new beginning. Trust in the Lord’s willingness to restore us, no matter how low we fall (Judges 16:28-30).

🙏 Prayer:
Merciful Lord, guard me from influences that weaken my spirit. In my weakness, lift me up and let Your strength renew my heart. Amen.

🔔 DAY 178 (SAT, JUNE 27, 2026)
📖 Judges 18–19

🛐 Daily Insight (Swedenborg-inspired):
The disturbing stories in these chapters reveal the chaos that ensues when truth is abandoned and “everyone does what is right in his own eyes.” They call us to anchor our lives in Divine order and guidance, seeking not our own way but the Lord’s truth and love (Judges 18:1; Judges 19:1).

🙏 Prayer:
O Lord, be my anchor and guide. Lead me from confusion into the light of Your truth and mercy. May I always seek Your way above my own. Amen.

🔔 DAY 179 (SUN, JUNE 28, 2026)
📖 Judges 20–21

🛐 Daily Insight (Swedenborg-inspired):
The final chapters portray sorrow and tragedy when disorder reigns, yet God's mercy shines as hope remains for restoration and peace. Even after devastation, the Lord calls us to rebuild, return, and seek the unity and goodness that come from Him alone (Judges 21:24-25; Arcana Coelestia 6301).

🙏 Prayer:
Lord, bring healing where there has been loss. Gather us into Your peace and help us seek unity and renewal through Your love. Amen.

🔔 DAY 180 (MON, JUNE 29, 2026)
📖 Romans 1–2

🛐 Daily Insight (Swedenborg-inspired):
Paul’s warning against judging others and his call to inner renewal remind us that true religion is not outward appearance but a life transformed by the Lord. The Lord desires that we seek genuine change in our hearts and lives, rather than justify ourselves while condemning others (Romans 2:1, 28-29; New Jerusalem and Its Heavenly Doctrine 159-160).

🙏 Prayer:
O Lord, help me look inward and let Your truth transform my spirit. Teach me to judge no one, and to live sincerely from You. Amen.

🔔 DAY 181 (TUE, JUNE 30, 2026)
📖 Romans 3–4

🛐 Daily Insight (Swedenborg-inspired):
Salvation comes through faith, yet true faith is living—a faith that produces good works out of love for the Lord and neighbor. Like Abraham, we are justified not by our own merits, but by trust in God’s mercy and a willingness to follow Him (Romans 4:3, 16; True Christian Religion 340).

🙏 Prayer:
Lord, let me trust in Your grace, and follow You with a heart willing to serve. Amen.

🔔 DAY 182 (WED, JULY 1, 2026)
📖 Romans 5–6

🛐 Daily Insight (Swedenborg-inspired):
Through the Lord’s love, we are raised from spiritual death to life—called to walk in newness, leaving behind the old self. True freedom is not license to sin, but the ability to do good by the Lord’s power (Romans 6:4, 14; Arcana Coelestia 10283:2).

🙏 Prayer:
Lord, help me to die to selfishness, and rise each day in love, joy, and service to You. Amen.

🔔 DAY 183 (THU, JULY 2, 2026)
📖 Romans 7–8

🛐 Daily Insight (Swedenborg-inspired):
The struggle between flesh and spirit is real—but through the Lord, victory is possible. He empowers us to overcome lower desires, filling us with peace and new life in His Spirit (Romans 7:22-25; 8:1-2; True Christian Religion 606).

🙏 Prayer:
Lord, in my struggles, fight for me. Send Your Spirit, that I may dwell in Your love and truth. Amen.

🔔 DAY 184 (FRI, JULY 3, 2026)
📖 Romans 9–10

🛐 Daily Insight (Swedenborg-inspired):
God’s mercy extends to all who open their hearts to Him, not by heritage but by living faith. The Lord welcomes anyone who hears His Word and allows it to become life within them (Romans 10:12-13; Arcana Coelestia 3926:4).

🙏 Prayer:
Lord, help me to truly hear Your voice and let Your Word become my way of life. Amen.

🔔 DAY 185 (SAT, JULY 4, 2026)
📖 Romans 11–12

🛐 Daily Insight (Swedenborg-inspired):
“Present your bodies as a living sacrifice”—a call to devote all we do to the Lord. He has a unique use for each of us, and when love and humility guide us, the church becomes one in Him (Romans 12:1, 4-5; Heaven and Hell 56).

🙏 Prayer:
O Lord, let my life be an offering of service, guided by Your love. Unite us in Your purpose. Amen.

🔔 DAY 186 (SUN, JULY 5, 2026)
📖 Romans 13–14

🛐 Daily Insight (Swedenborg-inspired):
To “put on the Lord Jesus Christ” means to live according to His commandments—the law of love. Mutual respect in spiritual matters fosters harmony and growth for all (Romans 13:8-10; 14:19; Charity 166).

🙏 Prayer:
Lord, clothe me in Your love. Help me be gentle with others’ journeys, honoring Your presence in every heart. Amen.

🔔 DAY 187 (MON, JULY 6, 2026)
📖 Romans 15–16

🛐 Daily Insight (Swedenborg-inspired):
Accepting and bearing with one another, as Christ received us, builds a spiritual community. True unity is in charity and humility—recognizing the Lord as the source of all good (Romans 15:5-7, 16:20; Arcana Coelestia 2385).

🙏 Prayer:
Lord, bless our relationships with patience and forgiveness. Make us one in Your love. Amen.

🔔 DAY 188 (TUE, JULY 7, 2026)
📖 Ruth 1–2

🛐 Daily Insight (Swedenborg-inspired):
Ruth’s devotion and willingness to leave all for Naomi symbolize spiritual loyalty and receptivity. The Lord cherishes a heart that seeks Him sincerely and serves others with kindness (Ruth 1:16-17, 2:12; Arcana Coelestia 4594).

🙏 Prayer:
Lord, grant me Ruth’s spirit—to follow wherever You lead, serving with faith and love. Amen.

🔔 DAY 189 (WED, JULY 8, 2026)
📖 Ruth 3–4

🛐 Daily Insight (Swedenborg-inspired):
The story of Ruth and Boaz shows the Lord’s providence in bringing about spiritual union—lifting us from emptiness to fruitfulness through loving kindness and faithfulness (Ruth 4:13-15; Arcana Coelestia 9213).

🙏 Prayer:
Thank You, Lord, for Your redeeming love. Complete in me the union of charity and faith, and bring forth good fruits. Amen.

🔔 DAY 190 (THU, JULY 9, 2026)
📖 1 Corinthians 1–2

🛐 Daily Insight (Swedenborg-inspired):
True wisdom is not the world’s, but the wisdom revealed by the Spirit—centered in the humility and love of the Lord Jesus Christ, who guides us into all truth (1 Corinthians 2:10-12; Divine Love and Wisdom 152).

🙏 Prayer:
Lord, teach me to trust Your wisdom and let Your Spirit give me understanding beyond my own. Amen.

🔔 DAY 191 (FRI, JULY 10, 2026)
📖 1 Corinthians 3–4

🛐 Daily Insight (Swedenborg-inspired):

O Lord, build Your temple within my heart. Bring my thoughts, affections, words, and actions into the order of Your wisdom and love. Amen.

🔔 DAY 240 (FRI, AUGUST 28, 2026)
📖 1 Kings 7

🛐 Daily Insight (Swedenborg-inspired):
The detailed work of the temple furnishings reminds us that even outward things can serve holy purposes when they are ordered toward the Lord. Our daily work, practical skills, and responsibilities can become acts of worship when they are done honestly, usefully, and from love for the neighbor (1 Kings 7:13-14, 40-51; New Jerusalem and Its Heavenly Doctrine 128).

🙏 Prayer:
O Lord, bless the ordinary work of my hands. Help me do every task honestly, carefully, and as a use that serves You and my neighbor. Amen.

🔔 DAY 241 (SAT, AUGUST 29, 2026)
📖 1 Kings 8

🛐 Daily Insight (Swedenborg-inspired):
At the dedication of the temple, Solomon acknowledges that heaven itself cannot contain the Lord, yet asks Him to hear prayer and forgive those who turn back to Him. The Lord is infinitely above us, yet intimately present with every repentant heart (1 Kings 8:27-30, 33-35; True Christian Religion 221; New Jerusalem and Its Heavenly Doctrine 160-161).

🙏 Prayer:
O Lord, You are greater than all heaven and yet near to me in prayer. Hear me, forgive me, and turn my heart again and again toward You. Amen.

🔔 DAY 242 (SUN, AUGUST 30, 2026)
📖 1 Kings 9–10

🛐 Daily Insight (Swedenborg-inspired):
The Lord tells Solomon that the temple’s holiness must be joined with integrity of heart and obedience. The Queen of Sheba recognizes the wisdom given to Solomon. Wisdom is beautiful when it leads us to honor the Lord and live according to His commandments, rather than merely admire knowledge (1 Kings 9:3-9; 10:6-9; New Jerusalem and Its Heavenly Doctrine 124).

🙏 Prayer:
O Lord, give me wisdom that changes the way I live. Keep my heart sincere, and help me use every gift You give me for what is good and true. Amen.

🔔 DAY 243 (MON, AUGUST 31, 2026)
📖 1 Kings 11–12

🛐 Daily Insight (Swedenborg-inspired):
Solomon’s heart is gradually turned by loves that draw him away from the Lord, and the kingdom becomes divided. Small compromises with self-love and worldly love can slowly weaken spiritual life. The Lord calls us to examine what rules our affections and return to wholehearted devotion (1 Kings 11:1-10; 12:26-30; New Jerusalem and Its Heavenly Doctrine 164-165).

🙏 Prayer:
O Lord, reveal anything that is turning my heart away from You. Unite my divided thoughts and desires, and lead me back into wholehearted faithfulness. Amen.

🔔 DAY 244 (TUE, SEPTEMBER 1, 2026)
📖 1 Kings 13–14

🛐 Daily Insight (Swedenborg-inspired):
The man of God is led astray when he accepts a message that contradicts the command he had received. Jeroboam also continues in false worship despite warning. We need to remain faithful to the Lord’s truth rather than follow voices that merely confirm what we want to believe (1 Kings 13:18-19; 14:7-10; True Christian Religion 220).

🙏 Prayer:
O Lord, give me discernment and steadfastness. Keep me from accepting falsehood because it is convenient, and help me remain faithful to Your Word. Amen.

🔔 DAY 245 (WED, SEPTEMBER 2, 2026)
📖 1 Kings 15–16

🛐 Daily Insight (Swedenborg-inspired):
The repeated record of kings who “did evil in the sight of the LORD” shows how easily one generation can continue the spiritual failures of another. Yet Asa’s reforms show that inherited patterns need not rule us. With the Lord’s help, we can remove what is harmful and choose a different path (1 Kings 15:11-14; 16:25-26; New Jerusalem and Its Heavenly Doctrine 163).

🙏 Prayer:
O Lord, help me recognize and reject harmful patterns in my life. Give me courage to choose what is good, true, and faithful to You. Amen.

🔔 DAY 246 (THU, SEPTEMBER 3, 2026)
📖 1 Kings 17–18

🛐 Daily Insight (Swedenborg-inspired):
Elijah’s life shows the Lord’s care in times of drought, scarcity, and conflict. On Mount Carmel, the issue is clear: the people must no longer halt between two opinions, but turn their hearts to the Lord. In our own spiritual droughts, the Lord calls us to renewed trust and wholehearted worship (1 Kings 17:13-16; 18:21, 36-39; New Jerusalem and Its Heavenly Doctrine 126).

🙏 Prayer:
O Lord, sustain me in times of spiritual dryness. Turn my heart fully toward You, and help me trust that Your love can provide what I need. Amen.

🔔 DAY 247 (FRI, SEPTEMBER 4, 2026)
📖 1 Kings 19–20

🛐 Daily Insight (Swedenborg-inspired):
Elijah, exhausted and discouraged, is met by the Lord with rest, food, and a “still small voice.” The Lord’s guidance is not always found in dramatic events; often He gently restores us and directs us one faithful step at a time (1 Kings 19:5-8, 11-13; 19:15-18; New Jerusalem and Its Heavenly Doctrine 163).

🙏 Prayer:
O Lord, meet me in my weariness. Quiet my anxious thoughts, restore my strength, and help me listen for Your gentle guidance. Amen.

🔔 DAY 248 (SAT, SEPTEMBER 5, 2026)
📖 1 Kings 21–22

🛐 Daily Insight (Swedenborg-inspired):
Ahab’s desire for Naboth’s vineyard becomes destructive when joined with Jezebel’s deceit and injustice. Later, Ahab prefers false prophets who tell him what he wants to hear. The Lord calls us to love justice, respect our neighbor’s rights, and welcome truth even when it challenges us (1 Kings 21:7-16, 25-29; 22:6-8; New Jerusalem and Its Heavenly Doctrine 124).

🙏 Prayer:
O Lord, guard me from selfish desire and from believing only what pleases me. Give me a love for justice and a humble willingness to receive Your truth. Amen.

🔔 DAY 249 (SUN, SEPTEMBER 6, 2026)
📖 Ephesians 1–2

🛐 Daily Insight (Swedenborg-inspired):
Paul describes the Lord’s desire to enlighten the eyes of our understanding and to make us alive in Him. We are saved from a life of evil so that we may become His workmanship, created for good works. Faith and charity receive their life from the Lord and come to expression in useful deeds (Ephesians 1:17-19; 2:8-10; True Christian Religion 355, 376).

🙏 Prayer:
O Lord, enlighten my understanding and make me alive in Your love. Lead me into the good works You prepare for me to do today. Amen.

🔔 DAY 250 (MON, SEPTEMBER 7, 2026)
📖 Ephesians 3–4

🛐 Daily Insight (Swedenborg-inspired):
Paul prays that we may be rooted and grounded in love, and he calls us to put off the old self and put on the new. This renewal is practical: speaking truth, refusing anger, working honestly, and building others up with our words (Ephesians 3:17-19; 4:22-25, 29-32; New Jerusalem and Its Heavenly Doctrine 165).

🙏 Prayer:
O Lord, root me deeply in Your love. Renew my mind and help me speak, work, and act in ways that build others up. Amen.

🔔 DAY 251 (TUE, SEPTEMBER 8, 2026)
📖 Ephesians 5–6

🛐 Daily Insight (Swedenborg-inspired):
Paul calls us to walk in love, walk as children of light, and put on the whole armor of God. Spiritual warfare is the conflict of truth against falsity and of good against evil. The Lord supplies the armor: truth, righteousness, faith, and the Word (Ephesians 5:1-2, 8-10; 6:10-18; Arcana Coelestia 1664).

🙏 Prayer:
O Lord, clothe me with Your truth and righteousness. Help me walk in love and stand firm against every evil and false thought that opposes You. Amen.

🔔 DAY 252 (WED, SEPTEMBER 9, 2026)
📖 2 Kings 1–2

🛐 Daily Insight (Swedenborg-inspired):
Ahaziah seeks help from a false god instead of the Lord, while Elisha faithfully follows Elijah until the end. Where we turn in times of uncertainty reveals what we trust. The Lord invites us to seek Him sincerely and to remain faithful in the path of service set before us (2 Kings 1:2-4; 2:2, 6, 9-10; New Jerusalem and Its Heavenly Doctrine 126).

🙏 Prayer:
O Lord, turn me away from false sources of security. Help me seek You first and remain faithful in the work and calling You give me. Amen.

🔔 DAY 253 (THU, SEPTEMBER 10, 2026)
📖 2 Kings 3–4

🛐 Daily Insight (Swedenborg-inspired):
In these accounts, the Lord provides water in a dry land, oil for a widow, food for others, and life for a child. The Lord’s providence reaches into practical human needs. He calls us to bring what little we have in trust and to use it in service to others (2 Kings 3:16-18; 4:1-7, 38-44; New Jerusalem and Its Heavenly Doctrine 124).

🙏 Prayer:
O Lord, provide for the needs of my life and teach me to trust Your care. Show me how to use what I have to bring help and hope to others. Amen.

🔔 DAY 254 (FRI, SEPTEMBER 11, 2026)
📖 2 Kings 5–6

🛐 Daily Insight (Swedenborg-inspired):
Naaman is healed when he humbles himself and obeys the simple instruction given through Elisha. His healing reminds us that pride resists the very means by which the Lord can restore us. The Lord asks us to receive His truth simply and to put it into practice (2 Kings 5:10-14; 6:16-17; New Jerusalem and Its Heavenly Doctrine 161).

🙏 Prayer:
O Lord, remove my pride and make me willing to obey Your simple guidance. Open my eyes to see that Your protection and help are nearer than I realize. Amen.

🔔 DAY 255 (SAT, SEPTEMBER 12, 2026)
📖 2 Kings 7–8

🛐 Daily Insight (Swedenborg-inspired):
The lepers who discover abundance refuse to keep the good news to themselves: “we do not well” if they remain silent. Blessings become fuller when shared. The Lord gives us truth, encouragement, and practical resources not only for ourselves but also for the good of others (2 Kings 7:8-9, 16; New Jerusalem and Its Heavenly Doctrine 124).

🙏 Prayer:
O Lord, keep me from holding Your blessings selfishly. Help me share hope, truth, and practical kindness with those around me. Amen.

🔔 DAY 256 (SUN, SEPTEMBER 13, 2026)
📖 2 Kings 9–10

🛐 Daily Insight (Swedenborg-inspired):
Jehu is used to bring judgment upon the house of Ahab and destroy Baal worship, yet he does not wholly walk in the Lord’s law. Removing one evil is not enough if the heart still clings to other self-serving loves. The Lord calls for a complete turning of life toward Him (2 Kings 10:28-31; New Jerusalem and Its Heavenly Doctrine 169).

🙏 Prayer:
O Lord, help me not to settle for partial change. Show me the evils I still protect, and lead me into a wholehearted life of obedience and love. Amen.

🔔 DAY 257 (MON, SEPTEMBER 14, 2026)
📖 2 Kings 11–12

🛐 Daily Insight (Swedenborg-inspired):
Joash begins well, and the temple is repaired through the willing gifts of the people. Repairing the Lord’s house can picture the renewal of worship and spiritual life: what has been neglected must be restored through sincere devotion and useful action (2 Kings 11:17-18; 12:4-15; True Christian Religion 221).

🙏 Prayer:
O Lord, restore what has grown neglected in my spiritual life. Renew my worship, strengthen my commitment, and help me contribute gladly to what serves Your kingdom. Amen.

🔔 DAY 258 (TUE, SEPTEMBER 15, 2026)
📖 2 Kings 13–14

🛐 Daily Insight (Swedenborg-inspired):
Elisha tells Joash to strike the ground with arrows, but the king stops too soon. The lesson is one of spiritual persistence: we should not become halfhearted in resisting the evils we recognize. The Lord gives strength for ongoing conflict as we continue to look to Him (2 Kings 13:17-19; Arcana Coelestia 8555).

🙏 Prayer:
O Lord, give me perseverance in spiritual growth. When I face recurring weakness, help me keep turning to You and never grow careless in the fight for what is good. Amen.

🔔 DAY 259 (WED, SEPTEMBER 16, 2026)
📖 2 Kings 15–16

🛐 Daily Insight (Swedenborg-inspired):
In a time of instability, King Ahaz looks to foreign power and even imitates a foreign altar rather than trusting the Lord. When fear rules us, we may look for solutions that compromise what we know is true. The Lord calls us back to trust, integrity, and faithful worship (2 Kings 16:7-10, 15-18; New Jerusalem and Its Heavenly Doctrine 128).

🙏 Prayer:
O Lord, keep fear from ruling my choices. Help me trust You rather than compromise truth for the sake of immediate security. Amen.

🔔 DAY 260 (THU, SEPTEMBER 17, 2026)
📖 2 Kings 17

🛐 Daily Insight (Swedenborg-inspired):
The fall of Israel is traced to persistent turning away from the Lord and following other gods. This sober chapter reminds us that spiritual decline is not sudden; it grows through repeated choices to neglect truth and embrace what is contrary to Divine life. Yet the Lord continually calls us to return (2 Kings 17:7-15, 35-39; New Jerusalem and Its Heavenly Doctrine 165).

🙏 Prayer:
O Lord, preserve me from gradual spiritual decline. Help me notice the small departures from Your ways and return to You with a sincere and willing heart. Amen.

🔔 DAY 261 (FRI, SEPTEMBER 18, 2026)
📖 2 Kings 18–19

🛐 Daily Insight (Swedenborg-inspired):
Hezekiah faces an overwhelming threat, but he brings the enemy’s message into the house of the Lord and prays. When fears speak loudly, we too can lay them before the Lord rather than letting them rule our minds. The Lord is able to defend and deliver beyond what we can see (2 Kings 18:5-7; 19:14-19, 32-35; Arcana Coelestia 1664).

🙏 Prayer:
O Lord, I bring my fears before You. Defend me from discouragement and falsehood, and give me peace through trust in Your saving power. Amen.

🔔 DAY 262 (SAT, SEPTEMBER 19, 2026)
📖 2 Kings 20–21

🛐 Daily Insight (Swedenborg-inspired):
Hezekiah turns to the Lord in illness and receives mercy, but later his pride leads him to display his treasures. His story reminds us to receive blessings humbly and remain watchful even after times of deliverance. The Lord calls us to keep our house—inwardly and outwardly—in order (2 Kings 20:2-6, 12-17; New Jerusalem and Its Heavenly Doctrine 163-165).

🙏 Prayer:
O Lord, receive my prayers in times of need and keep me humble in times of blessing. Set my inner life in order and guard me from pride. Amen.

🔔 DAY 263 (SUN, SEPTEMBER 20, 2026)
📖 2 Kings 22–23

🛐 Daily Insight (Swedenborg-inspired):
When the Book of the Law is found, Josiah listens, humbles himself, and leads the people in reform. The Word becomes living when it leads us to examine our lives, put away what is evil, and renew our covenant with the Lord (2 Kings 22:10-13, 18-20; 23:1-3, 24-25; New Jerusalem and Its Heavenly Doctrine 160-165).

🙏 Prayer:
O Lord, let Your Word awaken me and lead me to real change. Give me Josiah’s humble heart and the courage to remove what stands between me and You. Amen.

🔔 DAY 264 (MON, SEPTEMBER 21, 2026)
📖 2 Kings 24–25

🛐 Daily Insight (Swedenborg-inspired):
Jerusalem’s fall and the destruction of the temple are deeply sorrowful, showing the devastation that follows long resistance to Divine truth. Yet even in exile, the story closes with a sign of mercy toward Jehoiachin. The Lord never ceases to work toward restoration, and He can sustain hope even after failure and loss (2 Kings 24:18-20; 25:8-12, 27-30; New Jerusalem and Its Heavenly Doctrine 163).

🙏 Prayer:
O Lord, be with me in every season of loss, consequence, and rebuilding. Sustain hope within me, lead me to repentance, and restore my life through Your mercy. Amen.
